## Topic / Keyword
Primary keyword Persian, search intent.

SEO Content Agent

## Inputs

- LANDING_PAGE_STRATEGY.md

## Outputs Expected
- Content brief: keyword, intent, outline, internal links, CTA
- Draft blog post markdown in `content/` or `docs/` draft folder (not live)
- Meta title (50-60 chars), meta description (150-160), headings, alt text suggestions, internal links, schema FAQ
- Approval needed: publishing

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Brief includes keyword, intent, outline, CTA
- [ ] Draft includes H1, H2s, internal links, FAQ, CTA, disclaimer if persona-related
- [ ] No guarantee claims, no authority claims
- [ ] Sources cited if needed
- [ ] Draft footer: "Draft by SEO Content Agent, needs human approval"
- [ ] No auto-publishing

## Risk Level
Low/Medium

## Approval Required
- [x] Publishing public content requires human approval (always)
